data.long_meaning: Babban is a Hindi and Sanskrit name, derived from the term 'Baba' which means father or beloved. This name signifies a deep connection with one's roots and loved ones. The name Babban carries the meaning “Father, Beloved” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Babban usually hope their child will grow to embody father, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
